description: This file defines a BufferMemory node class for managing chat message memory, including initialization, retrieval, and management of chat messages stored in a database, using langchain and typeorm libraries.

classes.name: BufferMemory_Memory
classes.description: A node class implementing chat memory retrieval and management, conforming to INode interface.

classes.name: BufferMemoryExtended
classes.description: An extension of FlowiseMemory implementing chat message retrieval from a database with session management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes BufferMemoryExtended with session and database info, returning a BufferMemoryExtended instance.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages from database, optionally returning as base messages or IMessage objects, with support for prepending messages.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder for adding chat messages, managed on server level.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder for clearing chat messages, managed on server level.
